content:
All Models on One Screen

i10X offers a unified workspace aimed at eliminating the difficulty users face in managing different AI subscriptions. The platform brings together leading Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok in a single interface called “Chat Arena”. This structure allows users to test the same prompt across different models and compare the results in terms of accuracy and creativity.

Broad Tool Set and Agent Marketplace

The system is not limited to text-based chatbots and also covers image and video generation processes. By integrating media engines such as Nano Banana, DALL-E, Kling, and Veo, social media visuals or short videos can be produced. In addition, the platform offers specialized solutions for document-focused tasks such as PDF summarization and contract analysis.

Within the i10X infrastructure, there are more than 500 AI agents configured for specific tasks. These agents are classified in the following categories:

  • Business and Marketing Automations
  • SEO Optimization
  • Education and Research Assistants
  • Software and Coding Support

Cost and Access

As part of the NVIDIA Inception program, i10X aims to reduce multi-subscription costs. Unlike the total cost paid individually for services such as ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, and Midjourney, the platform offers these tools under a single membership model. Designed for entrepreneurs and content creators, the panel aims to increase efficiency by centralizing workflows.
